title: pterocarpus guianensis
intro: Pterocarpus guianensis, commonly known as the Dragon Blood Tree, is a tropical tree species native to the Guiana Shield region of South America. The tree is prized for its medicinal properties, which include various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, helping to alleviate conditions like fever, rheumatism, and wounds. Its therapeutic actions include cardiotonic, diuretic, and anti-rheumatic properties, making it useful in treating cardiovascular and kidney issues. The bioactive constituents of Pterocarpus guianensis include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
